thread:
sara: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — consolidating the testing/evals items we promised to add. TL;DR: regression suite expansion, curated prompt sets, a targeted load test, and one chaos drill. Owners + rough ETAs below.

omar: thanks — can we list owners and dates here so I can update the postmortem ticket? :eyes:

sara: yes. initial plan (very short):
```
- RDW-4321 | regression-suite: owner=leah | unblock by 2026-04-15 | add 12 new promptsets + 3 KV eviction tests
- RDW-4322 | promptset-curation: owner=leah + crowdreview | draft by 2026-04-08
- RDW-4323 | load-test-profile: owner=mike | target run 2026-04-20 | 10k qps spike scenario
- RDW-4324 | chaos-drill: owner=omar | dry-run 2026-04-22 | inject KV evictions + model fallback
```

leah: I can pick up the regression-suite and promptsets. planning to convert the postmortem examples into parametrized tests. will need a prompt review doc.

mike: taking load-test profile. question: do we use the dedicated infra or the hosted sandbox for the 10k qps? leaning dedicated burst pool to avoid noisy neighbors.

sara: dedicated burst pool for fidelity, but run smoke on hosted first. mike, can you add cost estimate to RDW-4323?

mike: yup, will attach a cost worksheet.

omar: I'll own the chaos drill coordination + runbook. want to pair with SRE during dry-run. Can we align on blast radius? suggestion: start with single-region, single-model fallback only.

sara: agreed. keep blast radius small for the first drill. include automated rollback steps and the fallback policy we discussed in the postmortem.

leah: quick note on promptsets: we should tag each prompt with the incident signature (kv-eviction-2026-03) and add a few negative control prompts. also we should add an eval threshold so alerts fire when regression > 3% failure.

sara: good call — add eval metric threshold to RDW-4321 and RDW-4322.

infra-bot: Created JIRA RDW-4321, RDW-4322, RDW-4323, RDW-4324 and linked to POSTMORTEM-1987.

deploy-bot: Scheduled smoke load run for RDW-4323 on 2026-04-10 14:00 UTC (sandbox).

omar: action items for the postmortem doc: 1) list owners and dates (done here), 2) link to test definitions and sample prompts, 3) add rollback/runbook links, 4) set recurring monthly check-in for test flakiness. I'll update POSTMORTEM-1987 after this thread.

sara: can everyone add a 1–2 line acceptance criteria to their JIRA tickets by EOD tomorrow? that'll make reviews faster.

leah: will do. planning to add sample prompt matrix and expected pass/fail tags.

mike: will put the load-profile and cost estimate in RDW-4323 by EOD.

omar: I'll draft the chaos runbook and send for review next week.

sara: thanks team. final ask — if you hit blockers for infra perms or quota, ping @infra oncall immediately. I'll follow up in the postmortem doc once tickets are updated. :thumbsup:

leah: noted.

mike: noted.

sara: scheduling a 30m sync for 2026-04-06 16:00 UTC to confirm owners and handoff. invite sent.

omar: on calendar.
